description: This file defines the absl::StatusOr<T> template class, which represents a union of a status and a value of type T, used for error handling and return values in C++ code. It includes class definitions, methods for accessing the value and status, and related utility classes and functions.

classes.name: BadStatusOrAccess
classes.description: Exception class thrown when accessing an invalid StatusOr value.

classes.name: StatusOr
classes.description: Template class representing a value or error status, used for error handling.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Checks if the StatusOr contains a valid value.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the status object associated with the StatusOr.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the contained value if ok, otherwise throws or terminates.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences to access the contained value.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Returns pointer to the contained value.

methods.name: value_or
methods.description: Returns the contained value or a default if not ok.
